name: Málaga, ES

nisar_gunw.coverage_note: NISAR GUNW is provisional and cryosphere-derived; urban coverage is NOT guaranteed (README §7). An intersecting granule must be verified visually before use.

recommended_stack.why: largest single-geometry stack (track 020/ASCENDING); 12 of 17 granules spread across 2026-06 .. 2026-10

opera_disp_s1.coverage_note: OPERA DISP-S1 is the calibrated, ready-made velocity product when it exists; it is the preferred build-time fallback for city-scale displacement.

sentinel1_slc.coverage_note: SLC here means an HyP3 on-demand InSAR stack is *possible* (needs an Earthdata login and credits); 5-year window, S1C included.

recommended_stack.why: no granule name carried a track/direction; this group cannot be verified as one geometry (218 granule(s)) — re-run `search` before downloading

egms.coverage_note: EGMS is a Copernicus portal download (EU only). Not scriptable without a manual AOI job; Málaga IS eligible and should be pulled by hand if the demo needs a calibrated velocity layer before our own InSAR finishes.

provenance.processing: NISAR L2 GUNW (unwrapped interferogram) > MintPy network inversion
provenance.method: ASF SearchAPI availability query at the AOI bbox; no processing performed at this stage. The source actually processed is recorded in chosen_source and repeated in docs/data-source-decision.md.
provenance.license: NASA open data (ASF DAAC; Earthdata terms)

recommendations: NISAR GUNW intersects the AOI (26 granules, 2026-06-20T05:22:52Z .. 2026-10-06T19:10:31Z); verify the interferogram actually covers the urban footprint before committing to a 12-day coherence threshold.
Fetch one geometry: `download --source nisar_gunw --stack recommended` plans track 020/ASCENDING (12 of 17 granules). Do not plan `--stack all`: it mixes tracks and the geometry guard refuses it.
No OPERA DISP-S1 for this AOI: fall back to HyP3 SLC pairs or the mock layer.
Sentinel-1 SLC archive present (250 granules in the 5-y window) → an HyP3 on-demand stack is feasible (6-day revisit: do NOT pool coherence thresholds with NISAR's 12-day).
Málaga is EU: EGMS can give a ready velocity field by hand tonight. Publish the detection limit and render flat deliberately.
